creator: The lock's creator never saw it finished.
船闸的设计者没能亲眼看到它完工。
creature: Some creature steals the bait every night.
creep: The tide creeps up the slip between the marks.
潮水沿着滑道在刻度间悄然上涨。
crew: The crew of four runs the whole ferry.
四名船员运转整条渡轮。
crime: Smuggling was the estuary's oldest crime.
走私是河口最古老的罪行。
criminal: The criminal court met in the toll house.
刑事法庭曾设在收费所。
crisis: The flood crisis brought the villages together.
洪水危机让各村团结起来。
crocodile: The carved crocodile on the stern came from a trade journey.
船尾的鳄鱼木雕来自一次远航贸易。
crop: The orchard's crop rides the barge every October.
果园的收成每年十月乘驳船运出。
cross: Cross at slack water or not at all.
要么平潮过河，要么不过。
